rationale: Exclude the proposed Lightstone Generation census holding because ArcLight and Blackstone no longer own it. ArcLight's live investments page still labels Lightstone Current, but primary and regulatory transaction evidence establishes that the owners sold the platform and that the relevant closing occurred on August 11, 2025. Lightstone was then divided between a three-gas-plant Cornerstone Generation perimeter and a separately held Gavin Generation perimeter, so Lightstone must not be merged into Cornerstone as though Cornerstone were a one-to-one rename. No Lightstone company exists in production or the evaluated seed. Because this census is limited to current manager holdings, creating a realized historical shell would introduce a stale PortCo instead of correcting one. The durable result is an exclusion with no database, seed, ownership, redirect, or publication mutation.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: A distinct four-plant U.S. power-generation platform comprising Darby, Gavin, Lawrenceburg, and Waterford, together with Lightstone Marketing, through its 2025 disposition.
identityResolution.duplicateResolution: Do not merge or supersede Lightstone Generation into Cornerstone Generation. Cornerstone was a newly formed purchaser and received only the three gas-fired plants and related perimeter; Gavin transferred through a separate purchaser structure.

assetBoundary.postExitResolution: Darby, Lawrenceburg, and Waterford entered the Cornerstone Generation perimeter controlled by ECP. Gavin transferred through a separate ECP-controlled structure with a Javelin minority interest. The split prevents a one-to-one Lightstone-to-Cornerstone canonical merge.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisition: AEP reported that the sale of the four competitive plants to Lightstone Generation, a Blackstone-and-ArcLight joint venture, closed on January 30, 2017 for approximately $2.1 billion.
acquisitionExitCheck.ownershipBeforeExit: A 2024 FERC filing identifies Lightstone Generation LLC as the direct or indirect owner of the five Lightstone seller entities and attributes 50% to ArcLight Fund VI and 50% in aggregate to Blackstone funds.
acquisitionExitCheck.exit: The later SEC transaction agreement defines August 11, 2025 as the Airborne Closing Date, while the Indiana regulatory docket records the associated post-closing notice. The transaction separated the Cornerstone and Gavin perimeters.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentOwnership: No current ArcLight or Blackstone ownership remains. ArcLight's Current label is contradicted by later closing evidence.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentReacquisitionSearch: No subsequent ArcLight or Blackstone reacquisition of Lightstone Generation was identified through August 13, 2026.

staleSourceConflict.resolution: Treat the live portfolio label as stale because later regulatory and transaction documents establish the completed 2025 disposition.
